title: 同相比例放大器
statement: 图示为理想运放构成的同相比例放大器，u_s = 2 V，R1 = 10 kΩ，Rf = 20 kΩ。
求电压放大倍数 u_o/u_s、输出电压 u_o 和 R1 中的电流 i1。

questions.explain: u_o = 3 × 2 V = 6 V，与 u_s 同相（同号）。
虚短：u_n = u_+ = u_s = 2 V，i1 = u_n/R1 = 2/10k = 0.2 mA；虚断使这一电流全部来自 Rf。

questions.ask: 从电压源 u_s 看进去，放大器的输入电阻是多少？
choices: 无穷大（u_s 不提供电流）
questions.explain: u_s 直接接在同相输入端，由“虚断”i_+ = 0，电源不输出电流，所以输入电阻为无穷大——这是同相放大器相对反相放大器的主要优点。

hints: 先用“虚短”求反相端 n 的电位。
R1 与 Rf 串联构成对 u_o 的分压器：u_n = u_o·R1/(R1 + Rf)。
solution: **2. 虚断：** 反相端不取电流，R1 与 Rf 中是同一个电流 i1 = u_n/R1 = 2/10 kΩ = **0.2 mA**。
**4. 放大倍数：** u_o/u_s = 1 + Rf/R1 = **3**（总是 ≥ 1，输出与输入同相）。

en.title: Non-inverting amplifier
statement: The ideal op-amp forms a non-inverting amplifier with v_s = 2 V, R1 = 10 kΩ, Rf = 20 kΩ.
Find the voltage gain v_o/v_s, the output voltage v_o and the current i1 in R1.

questions.explain: v_o = 3 × 2 V = 6 V, in phase (same sign) with v_s.
Virtual short: v_n = v+ = v_s = 2 V, so i1 = v_n/R1 = 2/10k = 0.2 mA; by the virtual open this whole current comes through Rf.

questions.ask: What is the input resistance of the amplifier seen by the source v_s?
questions.explain: v_s is connected straight to the non-inverting input, which draws no current (virtual open). The source delivers no current, so the input resistance is infinite — the main advantage over the inverting amplifier.

hints: Use the virtual short to get the potential of the inverting node n.
R1 and Rf in series form a voltage divider across v_o: v_n = v_o·R1/(R1 + Rf).
solution: **1. Virtual short:** v_n = v− = v+ = v_s = 2 V.
**2. Virtual open:** no current enters the inverting input, so R1 and Rf carry the same current i1 = v_n/R1 = 2/10 kΩ = **0.2 mA**.
**4. Gain:** v_o/v_s = 1 + Rf/R1 = **3** (always ≥ 1, output in phase with the input).
